'''Seldin''' was a [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and member of the [[Corellian Jedi|Green Jedi]]. Seldin served during the [[third Galactic War]] fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and was killed defending the [[Meridian Complex]] against an Imperial attack. They were an adept of the [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]] stance, dual wielding two green lightsabers.<ref name="Onslaught" />
